summary: Burundi’s restoration pledges emphasize forest expansion and watershed rehabilitation: reported afforestation/reforestation rates of 4 ha/year and 8,000 ha/year, five-year totals of 20,000 and 40,000 ha, 53,340 ha by 2030, a 160,000-ha forest-cover increase with both 2025 and 2027 deadlines reported, 24,000 ha in KUMOSO, and 299,100 ha under watershed management. The 160,000-ha increase equals about 53% of the current forest area of 3,016 km². Conservation targets include 20% forest cover by 2025 versus 11.2% currently; bamboo and riverbank targets of 2,500, 5,300 and 22,500 ha; protection of 90,000 ha of floodplains and 250 water sources; and a separate 6,761-km² floodplain figure. Agriculture pledges include replacing 100% of mineral fertilizer with manure by 2030, 4,280 ha of moringa, 100,000 climate-resilient cropping practices, 10,000 households using rainwater for agriculture, and smaller area targets. Integrated measures include 3,000 agro-silvopastoral pilot sites.
